corpus: 16 manually curated current RAE artifacts/material nodes: FRANK C9; ClayCode lanes A/B/C/D; Hyperposition H6; UnifiedDB U2; ClayGraph G2a + accepted G0; GWT R5/R6; CACC; E-CERT2; three external temporal/poisoning memory sources.
gold: Frozen exact artifact identity per question before scoring; manually curated, therefore staged mechanism benchmark only.
key_negative: Graph propagation hurt a precise FRANK-C9 lookup: the FRANK seed's strongly linked ClayCode neighbors outranked the exact FRANK artifact. More graph was worse than lexical baseline on this small precision-oriented set.
external_memory_query: Intent-typed graph improved the external memory-poisoning query from rank 3 in the lexical baseline to rank 2, but did not make it top-1; evidence-class intent was useful but insufficient.
interpretation: G3 supports route-selective graph use, not universal propagation. Exact/identity questions should BYPASS or sharply cap graph gain; associative/temporal questions remain candidates for structured expansion.
limitations: graph links hand-authored for mechanism test
